title: Germany's car crisis: Can the 35-hour workweek survive?
summary: German carmakers want employees to work 40 hours instead of the current 35 without extra pay, arguing it would improve competitiveness. Unions strongly oppose the proposal and view it as an attack on workers' rights.

title: Refugees in South Africa fear new attacks as September 30 deadline looms
summary: Refugees in Durban say they have nowhere safe to return to after being forced from a makeshift camp.
